title: Directed finite-generation exhaustion of an abelian sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space whose quasi-compact open subsets form a basis. For each open $U$ put $E_U=j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_U$, with constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and open extension by zero [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Every abelian sheaf $F$ on $X$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] admits a diagram $D:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X)$ on a nonempty directed preordered set $I$, and compatible monomorphisms $c_i:D_i\to F$, forming a colimit cocone. Each $D_i$ admits an epimorphism $\bigoplus_{a=1}^{n_i}E_{U_{i,a}}\to D_i$ for a finite family of quasi-compact opens, allowing $n_i=0$. Both $I$ and the stalk groups may be taken in the same universe as $X$. Colimits are as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
